title: PM–Eng Lead 1:1 prep: API/Console/Dedicated/Private
content:
Date: 2026-02-20
Attendee: Alex Morgan (PM) -> Samir Patel (Eng Lead)
Purpose: Quick sync to align on priorities and unblock Dedicated/Private rollouts, Console UX changes, and a couple of API stability items.

Agenda:
- Quick status (5m)
  - Dedicated capacity beta: perf numbers, SLOs, current customer feedback
  - Private deployment early adopters: network/KMS issues + install docs
  - Console changes: rollout plan for per-route tracing and rollout UI
  - API stability: retry/fallback behavior, error surface consistency

Notes / context to bring up:
- Dedicated: internal perf tests show 12–18% higher p95 on long-context (>8k) workloads vs expectations. Suspect kernel selection on A100 nodes for quantized models. Need to confirm whether fallback to older kernel reduces latency but increases cost. (Related: JIRA-4521)
- Private: two EAP customers hit networking timeouts during config sync (edge case with strict outbound policies). Proposed short-term: add a non-blocking config-sync mode + clearer required ports in install guide. Longer-term: implement an agent-based pull model.
- Console: Product wants to expose per-route latency/cost breakdowns in the UI for customers on Dedicated. UX design ready; Eng asks whether we can prioritize the tracing hooks for the next sprint or pair with QA for a feature-flagged soft launch.
- API stability: A recent outage surfaced inconsistent error codes across model variants when fallback happened. Need standardized error taxonomy and a small compatibility shim by next week. (Related: JIRA-4890)

Discussion points to cover with Samir:
1) Dedicated perf regression
   - Is this regression from kernel change or batching logic?
   - Can infra revert that kernel selection safely for Dedicated-pinned customers?
   - Ask Samir: rough ETA to patch + test matrix required for longer contexts (who owns tests?)

2) Private EAP install reliability
   - Confirm intended short-term mitigation (non-blocking sync + doc updates). Ask Samir to assign an owner for docs/installer change.
   - Discuss feasibility of agent-based pull model (scope, infra dependencies, security review timetable).

3) Console rollout priorities
   - Engineering bandwidth: can we ship tracing hooks in the sprint after next? If not, propose feature-flagged rollout to a small set of customers.
   - Ask about observability retention cost and whether we should add opt-in defaults.

4) API error standardization
   - Propose a 3-day spike to produce a compatibility shim and map inconsistent codes to a canonical set.
   - Who on infra/serving-runtime owns the shim? Clarify rollback plan if shim causes regressions.

5) Cross-cutting: release windows and Dedicated commitments
   - Reminder: there are two enterprise customers wanting Dedicated SLA by end of Q2. Need alignment on release freeze + hardening windows.

Decisions to propose / seek:
- Short-term: revert kernel selection for Dedicated-pinned nodes as a mitigation while we fix kernel heuristics. (Decision requested from Samir)
- Short-term: add non-blocking config-sync and update install doc for Private EAPs.
- Mid-term: scope spike for agent-based pull model for Private installs.
- API: 3-day spike to standardize error codes + rollout shim; do feature flag for fallback behavior.

Action items (owner / due):
- Samir: confirm whether reverting kernel selection is safe and schedule rollback if needed. Due: 2026-02-25
- Samir -> Eng infra lead (Jordan): run extended context perf matrix (4k/8k/16k sequences) and share results. Due: 2026-03-05
- Alex: draft short install doc changes + required ports checklist and post to confluence; loop Liu for review. Due: 2026-02-23
- Liu Chen: prototype non-blocking config-sync in sandbox and share test plan. Due: 2026-02-28
- Samir: nominate owner for agent-prototype spike and rough estimate for scope. Due: 2026-03-03
- Platform SRE: prepare release freeze calendar for Dedicated SLAs and send to PM/Eng by end of week. Due: 2026-02-24
- Eng (owner TBD): 3-day spike for error shim + automated tests. Alex to create JIRA ticket and tag infra/serving-runtime. Due: 2026-02-27

Open questions / parking lot:
- If reverting kernel selection increases cost for Dedicated customers, how do we communicate tradeoffs? Need pricing note from finance.
- Should per-route tracing be stored in a separate retention tier (cheaper) by default? Finance + Product to decide.
- Private agent model: security review estimated time? Add to roadmap conversation.

Prep for next 1:1:
- Samir to bring perf matrix results + recommendation (revert vs patch)
- Engineering lead for Private to share prototype status
- Draft messaging for customers if we revert kernel selection (include tone + technical appendix)

Quick talking script for the start (1–2 sentences):
- "Thanks — quick check-in on Dedicated perf and Private install flakiness. Two proposed short-term mitigations (kernel revert + non-blocking sync) that I want your sign-off on so we can move fast and not block our EAPs. Also want to confirm owner for the error-code shim."

Notes to self after meeting: (fill after 1:1)
- [ ] Capture final decision about kernel revert + link to rollback PR
- [ ] Confirm owner for agent spike and add to roadmap board
- [ ] Update customer comms draft if we revert
